    The leading Wind-Optimized PV (WOPV) technology
    Designed for PV module and solar glass manufacturers
    A passive, field-proven approach to reducing dust accumulation in PV modules — designed for OEM integration

    Soiling is not just an operational issue

    Dust-related losses are typically addressed through cleaning, coatings, or maintenance.

    These approaches treat symptoms — not the root cause.

    Dust accumulation is a design problem

    What is Wind-Optimized PV (WOPV)?

    A passive, physics-based design method that uses wind-activated MicroThreads to prevent long-term dust accumulation in PV modules, throughout the panel’s entire lifetime.

    Why WOPV works

    Natural wind induces continuous micro-movement in the MicroThreads.

    This ongoing disturbance prevents dust particles from settling into stable layers on the module surface.

    The goal is not to remove dust — but to prevent its accumulation.

    Proven in the field

    WOPV has been tested in real outdoor environments over multiple years and across diverse climates.
    Validation is based on more than five years of accumulated field experience, spanning dozens of sites and over 5,000 PV modules.

    Results show consistent long-term behavior driven by underlying physics rather than site-specific conditions, with a typical observed energy uplift of ~1–2%.

    Long-term outdoor time-lapse (prototype).
    Dust reaches the surface but does not form a stable layer.

    How standards begin

    Many PV design features — from anti-reflective coatings to bifacial modules — began as optional innovations before becoming industry standards.

    Early adopters influence acceptance, benchmarks, and best practices.

    WOPV is at that stage today.
